articleTitle: Widely Linear Constrained Complex-Valued Least M-estimation Algorithm for Adaptive Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In this paper, a widely-linear constrained complex-valued least mean M-estimate (WL-CCLMM) algorithm is derived for processing impulsive noise and complex-valued signal in adaptive beamforming. In the proposed algorithm, a widely-linear structure is used to improve steady-state performance by making use of the second-order (SO) non-circular property of the input random vector. Weight constraints are introduced to prevent distortion in desired signal directions and nulls in interference signal directions. We also adopt the M-estimator function to decrease the influence of outliers caused by impulsive noise. Experimental results verify that the WL-CCLMM algorithm realizes lower steady-state performance and better beam pattern effect in adaptive beamforming with different noise environment, compared to other previous robust algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation Optimization of Data Mining Model Based on Fuzzy Improved Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The goal of data mining (DM) is to find some important patterns and trends from the complicated data. How to select useful information quickly, efficiently and accurately from the vast amount of data has become an urgent problem. Clustering algorithm refers to the algorithm process of grouping a large quantity of data objects with similarity and proximity, so as to cluster approximate data information and facilitate DM calculation. This paper mainly studies the fuzzy improved clustering algorithm of DM model in big data and analyzes the incremental fuzzy clustering algorithm (FCA) of DM model in big data. The experimental results show that the accuracy of data mining model will be improved when the quantity of samples reaches a certain level. Compared with the traditional K-Means algorithm, the accuracy of this algorithm has obvious advantages, up to 97.88%. The method in this paper not only has good prediction ability, but also provides a more concise rule base, which provides a better tool for analyzing the nature of the problem and discovering the hidden knowledge in the data.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent New Model for the Organic Integration of Computer Networks and English Teaching Courses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In traditional teaching models, the role of teachers is relatively singular. Teachers are the controllers of the classroom, and students spend less than 10% of their time speaking English besides being asked to answer questions. Therefore, it is difficult for teachers to become promoters, facilitators, or coordinators of students' learning. Therefore, this article conducts research on the intelligent new mode design through the organic integration of computer networks and EL T (English Language Teaching) courses. When designing teaching activities, we should pursue the mutual promotion between the application of information technology and the transformation of teaching methods. Through the comprehensive application of information technology and various activity methods, information technology can not only support existing teaching methods, but also promote the transformation of teaching methods. Through the analysis of the research results indicating the weekly learning volume of EL T courses, it can be found that only a few students consider it easy, while the majority of students believe that the course volume is large, with an average proportion of up to 52.11 %. It can be seen that students can only engage in effective communication between students and teachers on the basis of self-learning and understanding, and their creative thinking can be effectively improved during the learning process.

articleTitle: Application Processing of Film Industrial Grade Color Grading Simulation Style Based on LUT Color Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Color matching algorithm refers to an algorithm that transfers the color information in the source image to the target image for two images, so that the target image and the source image have similar color perception. The color matching algorithm proposed in this paper can automatically find the feature points in the image for matching without user intervention, and generate 3DLUT to perform color matching on the image. Since the matching result is expressed by 3DLUT, it is more suitable for the processing of film-level color grading simulation style.

articleTitle: Terminal ID Authentication System Based on Digital Certificate
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: System security login and ID authentication are the first level in the security system, and the basis for implementing access control, which plays a very important role in the field of system security. This paper mainly introduces a terminal ID authentication system based on digital certificate. Through this authentication mechanism, the server can identify whether the real identity of the user is consistent with its claimed identity and prevent illegal users from invading the Web application system. Using digital certificate to encrypt authentication information can effectively prevent network eavesdropping. Using digital certificate to complete mutual authentication between users and servers and using challenge response to realize the function of one secret at a time. By using the signature and signature technology of data certificate, the non-repudiation of information can be achieved, and the non-repudiation of electronic data sharing and transmission can be ensured by electronic means. After the deployment and testing of the single sign-on system, the system runs stably and achieves the expected effect.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Clinical Auxiliary Diagnosis and Treatment Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In recent years, experts and scholars at home and abroad have continuously increased their research on AI technology, which has made the level of AI develop rapidly and has been applied in work, study and life. By studying big data, summarizing and discovering laws, we can conclude the differences with regularity to diagnose diseases. This paper studies the application of AI(artificial intelligence) technology in clinical auxiliary diagnosis and treatment equipment. An improved FA(Firefly algorithm) is proposed for diabetes feature selection, which relates the update of firefly position with the global optimal solution, so as to avoid falling into local optimal solution. PNN (Probability neural network) was used to establish a diabetes diagnosis model, and the diagnosis results were analyzed. The research results show that the improved FA algorithm is better than the results before feature selection in the dimension, classification accuracy and running time of the optimal feature subset, and can filter out redundant features well, so it is suitable for the reduction of diabetes feature set. Under the same conditions, the accuracy of the improved FA model network model is higher than that of the standard model. The reliability of the application of AI technology in clinical auxiliary diagnosis and treatment equipment is verified.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Scalable Smart Contracts for Ethereum - An Example of Digital Certificates
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Based on the concept of contract separation proposed by OpenZeppelin platform, this thesis realizes on-chain upgrading by splitting the complete smart contract into main contract and agent contract. Taking the digital certificate smart contract as an example, this paper proposes the design and implementation of an upgradable digital certificate smart contract based on Ethereum. This method can be used to upgrade on-chain at a lower cost and improve the security and maintainability of the smart contract when there are code vulnerabilities or the need to expand the service. Experimental results show that the digital certificate smart contract designed based on this paper can realize the full life cycle of on-chain upgrade, while not affecting the normal invocation of users.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Face Recognition System Based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Intelligent facial recognition technology is a very important research direction among various biometric recognition technologies. Intelligent facial recognition is extracting facial features through computer programming and matching identities based on the extracted features. This article studies intelligent facial recognition based on an adaptive genetic algorithm (AGA), and experiments have shown that the algorithm performs well in facial posture and expression. In the case of small samples, the recognition rate is higher, and the operation speed is faster. This chapter compares the algorithm proposed in this article with the main classical algorithms and tests the algorithm's performance and effectiveness. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good performance in intelligent face recognition. Intelligent facial recognition systems require detecting video data first, to increase the richness of system samples. Improve the credibility of the system. It can be seen that the algorithm in this article has good performance under both facial expressions and small poses, and still has a good recognition rate under significant angle rotation conditions.

articleTitle: Improved Particle Swarm Optimization-Based Node Migration Deployment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In this paper, we mainly consider the problems of coverage and communication blind areas that easily arise after nodes are randomly deployed in areas with harsher natural environments, hazards or battlefields. In order to maximize the WSN coverage performance, a Resampling Particle Swarm Optimization (RPGSOLA) algorithm based on Learning Automata (LA) and Glowworm Swarm Optimization(GSO) is proposed. This algorithm introduces GSO into the Particle Swarm algorithm and combines it with LA to achieve migration deployment control of nodes, then optimize network coverage rate. Simulation experiments show that the network coverage performance of the RPGSOLA is a significant improvement on the RPSOLA algorithm and the RPSO algorithm, meanwhile, it verifies that the node cooperative sensing model obviously outperforms the disc sensing coverage model.

articleTitle: Research on Ancient Text Classification and Topic Extraction Model Based on Natural Language Processing and Spss Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: This study uses natural language processing and SPSS data analysis to classify and extract themes of ancient book literature data, aiming to reduce duplication of effort and provide reference for the field of ancient book research. Through the systematic collection and analysis of ancient book data, the research progress is counted, sorted out and identified. We conducted in-depth research on the timeline, publication periodicals, and research hotspots of ancient books services. The study found that the future of Chinese ancient book research should focus on: (1) increase publicity and investment to increase the influence in the field of ancient book research; (2) deepen research depth and promote the output of high-quality academic papers; (3) strengthen cross-research, to promote the in-depth development of the field of ancient book research.

articleTitle: Optimal Networking Scheme for Stealth Target Detection by Multi-Sensor Detection Coalition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: We develop a research discussion around multi-sensor cross-suggestion technology to build a multi-sensor coalition using multi-sensor cross-suggestion technology for the problem of high speed and stealthy targets in the proximity of airspace that are difficult to track and detect accurately for a long time. In building the multi-sensor detection alliance, the objective function is established with saving the detection time of individual sensors and maximizing the utilization efficiency of sensors, and tracking accuracy and time are taken as constraints. To find the optimal solution of the multi-sensor detection coalition, an improved bat algorithm is proposed, and the final simulation results show that the algorithm is faster in convergence and more accurate in solution than the ant colony and gray wolf algorithms, and is more adaptable to the rapidly changing situation of the battlefield situation in the new era.

articleTitle: Temperature and Humidity Monitoring System of Outdoor Terminal Box in Substation Based on Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: For the purpose of accurately and real-time monitoring the temperature and humidity status of the outdoor terminal box of the substation, a temperature and humidity monitoring system for the outdoor terminal box of the substation based on wireless communication technology is designed. The SHT11 temperature and humidity sensor collects the temperature and humidity information of the terminal box, and transmits the information through the wireless communication network. LSTM model is used to identify temperature and humidity anomalies. If there is an abnormal state, it drives the buzzer to alarm. The experimental analysis shows that the temperature and humidity acquisition deviation values of the designed system for the outdoor terminal box of the substation are 0.l°C and 0.1%, respectively. When the temperature and humidity status is abnormal, the alarm time of the buzzer is highly consistent with the actual time, which can accurately and real-time monitor the temperature and humidity status of the terminal box. The wireless communication network used by the system has good anti-interference performance, and the signal strength and data packet receiving ability are significant.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Digital Currency on Commercial Bank Deposit Business
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Digital currency is an important symbol of the deep integration of technology and finance, bringing both opportunities and challenges to commercial banks. Based on the theoretical analysis of the impact of basic currency, currency circulation speed on deposits, and the impact of digital currency on the deposit creation ability of commercial banks, this article dynamically demonstrates the relationship between the use rate of digital currency and the change rate of commercial bank deposits through a cointegration test. Conclusion: The impact of digital currency on each factor that affects bank deposit creation varies, and the final result needs to be compared to the size of each factor affected by digital currency, and propose corresponding suggestions for the response of commercial banks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Power Engineering Bid Evaluation Expert Database Based on Latent Semantic Index
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In order to further improve the operation and management efficiency and quality of the bid evaluation expert database of power grid enterprises, comprehensively improve the professional skills and quality of bid evaluation experts, and promote the healthy development of bidding work of power grid enterprises. This project plans to build a power engineering bid evaluation expert database based on LSI(Latent semantic index). And LSI technology is applied to the retrieval technology of expert database. First of all, after the original data information of the expert database is labeled and weighted, a series of feature vectors are formed, and the combination of these vectors becomes a word-document matrix. Secondly, the data source document matrix is processed, features are extracted and related features are clustered to form a potential semantic space. Finally, an LSI is established and searched through the latent semantic space. The test results show that this method can retrieve more valuable information in accurate meaning vocabulary retrieval, and the precision rate is higher than that of traditional retrieval methods. LSI technology is applied to the expert database of power engineering bid evaluation, and the results obtained are incomparable to those obtained by ordinary indexes, which really improves the search efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Evaluation of Mixed Teaching for Public Art Majors Combined with Fuzzy Data Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness evaluation of mixed teaching for public art majors, this paper constructs a mixed teaching evaluation model for public art majors with fuzzy processing technology, and tests the effectiveness of mixed teaching mode through this model. On the basis of summarizing the comprehensive characteristics of design thinking models in the field of education, combined with the common task-driven teaching methods in information technology courses, this paper constructs a mixed teaching mode based on design thinking for skill courses and work production courses. Moreover, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to quantify each evaluation index in the evaluation system of mixed teaching effect. From the experimental analysis, it can be seen that the evaluation method of mixed teaching effectiveness for public art majors with fuzzy data processing technology proposed in this paper has good results.

articleTitle: A Research on Consumer Purchase Behavior Decision Model Directed by Quality and Safety Information – an example based on Children's Products
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: This article made research on: the market and consumption status of children's products as well as some of the issues faced by consumers, and the attention of consumers to the quality and safety of children's products. More specifically, the research examined the impact of product quality and safety information on consumers' decision-making behavior while purchasing children's products. As it is shown by the research, the children's product market is characterized by: first, a focus on toy products; second, a high recognition on domestic brands; third, significant differences in brand selections among consumers at different income levels; secondly, in terms of issues faced by consumers of children's products, it was found that the quality and safety issues exist in such fields as toys, food, stationery, and clothing and the irrational consumption was brought about by certain new consumption patterns. Moreover, the consumers' purchasing concerns were found mainly rooted on four aspects as safety, functionality, environmental protection, and price, there is no significant correlation between economic income and the level of attention paid to the safety of children's products; Fourthly, there is a significant correlation between consumer satisfaction and brand types, with nearly half of consumers inclined towards selecting the domestic brands. The decision on choosing domestic brands is affected mainly by such concerns as safety and reliable materials, sturdiness and durability, humanized design, and high cost-effectiveness.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of the Impact of Digital Currency on Currency Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Digital currency is another revolution in the form of currency, greatly changing the business model of traditional finance and having an impact on the monetary multiplier generated in monetary policy transmission. This article is based on quarterly data from 2015 to 2022, using Granger causality test and Johansen cointegration test, and using the VEC model for error correction. The results indicate that in the short term, digital currencies exacerbate the volatility of currency multipliers; After a very lengthy period of time, the rate of increase in size per unit time digital currency (GEM) is positively correlated with the currency multiplier, and digital currency can maintain an equilibrium in the currency multiplier.

articleTitle: The Composition and Security Strategy of Semi-Centralized SDN Routing in Data Center Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In the operation of data center network system, the calculation and distribution of route is mainly operated by the central controller, so it has become the vulnerable point of network system operation. In the development of modern science and technology, in order to effectively solve this problem, scholars put forward the application of semi-centralized routing technology, which requires all switch nodes to be free from router control and be able to form relatively basic Liu tables independently, thus completing data forwarding. In this paper, we learn.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Big Data Technology in the Simulation Design of Mathematical Models for Agricultural Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: With the advent of the information age, big data is maturing. How to effectively apply big data analysis technology to accelerate the process of agricultural modernization and promote the healthy, stable and sustainable growth of the agricultural economy has become a focus of attention. Data analysis is a special operation mode in the information age, which has many characteristics, such as high efficiency and accuracy. With the passage of time, its application field is also expanding. At present, data analysis has also been applied in modern agricultural production. Driven by big data, in order to innovate the research methods of agricultural economic forecasting, this article is based on the improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) mathematical model of agricultural economic analysis, and simulates its application effect in agricultural economic forecasting under the background of agricultural modernization. The results show that the simulated values are in good agreement with the actual values, and the BP neural network (BPNN) model based on improved PSO has high prediction accuracy, and the model is universal and practical. From the aspects of accuracy, rationality and practicability, the improved PSO algorithm is more suitable for agricultural economic forecasting research.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Protection Education of Red Culture Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In some places, the dissemination route of red culture is relatively single, which fails to dig deep into the connotation of red cultural resources, and some red cultural resources are showing signs of gradual disappearance. In this paper, these red cultural heritages are digitally stored in the platform, and displayed and disseminated through the platform, which can make more people know about red culture without leaving home and is beneficial to red culture education. The overall architecture of the red culture digital protection platform adopts independent MVC architecture based on Java EE platform. As an independent unit, big data analysis engine is developed and built on Linux server as a whole, and MySQL database is used as a data integration scheme. The improved CF(collaborative filtering) algorithm is used to recommend red cultural resources. The experimental results show that the value of MAE calculated by the input matrix preprocessing scheme of CF algorithm proposed in this paper is lower than that of the traditional CF recommendation algorithm, and it can better deal with the sparsity of input matrix. Providing specific users with more concerned resources and information through big data platform and recommendation algorithm is an important technical means to improve user experience and expand the attraction of the platform. It solves the storage and retrieval problems of a large number of scanned documents and textual documents of folk cultural materials, which is beneficial to red culture education.

articleTitle: Privacy Protection and Query of Industrial Park Energy Usage Data Based on Searchable Encryption and Secure Multiparty Computation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In the industrial park, it involves a lot of energy consumption data, such as energy consumption, equipment running status and so on. These data packets contain business secrets and sensitive information of the enterprise. If these data are accessed or leaked without authorization during transmission and storage, they will face the risks of commercial competition and the infringement of intellectual property rights. Because the protection of data privacy needs to encrypt data, the traditional query method will be greatly affected. Therefore, a method is needed to ensure data privacy and realize efficient query and calculation. In this paper, a method of privacy protection and query of energy consumption data in industrial parks based on searchable encryption and secure multi-party computing is proposed. The results show that when the encrypted files in the database are increasing, the security of the master node based on searchable encryption and secure multi-party computing is higher than the traditional algorithm. By combining encryption technology and secure computing technology, this method realizes the privacy protection and efficient query of energy consumption data in industrial parks, which can meet the query requirements of users while protecting data privacy, and is widely used in industrial parks and other fields.

Author Keywords: energy consumption data of industrial parks

articleTitle: Semantic Extraction of Basketball Game Video Based on Domain Knowledge and Depth Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In recent years, a large number of video-based multimedia data have appeared. How to effectively deal with these huge amounts of video data is a hot research issue at present. With the development of multimedia technology and the emergence of information superhighway, the storage and transmission of digital video is no longer a difficult thing. Holding different sports events directly leads to the explosive growth of sports video data. Therefore, efficient sports video analysis is necessary. Video features contain rich semantic information, and the research on concise representation and efficient extraction methods of motion features is one of the key technologies of video semantic analysis. According to the characteristics of video semantic analysis, the motion features are divided into three categories, and the various motion features are characterized and extracted, respectively. The relevant extraction experiments show that this method can effectively extract the motion features required for semantic analysis. At the same time, a motion-based video semantic analysis prototype system is realized on the basis of motion feature extraction. The extraction and retrieval of video content is an important means to solve the “semantic gap”. Although there have been many studies on content-based video retrieval, this technology is still far from satisfying the general needs of users.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mining and Retrieval of Music Data Based on Long-Term and Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In the era of digitalization and networking, multimedia content represented by images, audio and video has become the most important data carrier on the Internet Information superhighway. The traditional single word search method can no longer meet the needs of digital multimedia information search. At the same time, content-based multimedia information search technology has put forward higher requirements for devices and users. Therefore, search technology based on music emotions has emerged. However, currently, most music searches are based on music style, song titles, album titles, etc., without considering the emotional factors of the music itself. So, searching by “music emotion category” is currently a requirement for applications. This project aims to explore the functional relationship between music feature information and music emotion cognition from the perspective of machine learning, and compare the performance of SVM algorithms; Based on the emotional database of Chinese ethnic music, BP neural network, linear regression and other methods are used to model and optimize the emotions of music, ultimately achieving accurate recognition of music emotions.

Author Keywords: short-term and long-term memory neural network

articleTitle: Research on Evolution of Quality Chain Network Model Based on Multi-Attribute Weighting of Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Using the linear optimal connection mechanism of complex network model, a multi-attribute weighted quality chain network model construction method is proposed. Firstly, the enterprise node in the quality chain is defined to have its self attributes of quality elements and node business relevance. Secondly, the degree and the intermediate number are combined to comprehensively consider the local and global characteristics of the network to express the network attributes of the node, and the multi-attribute weighted quality chain network edge connection strategy algorithm is designed under the combination with the node's own attribute weighting. Finally, the simulation results show that the quality chain network model established by this strategy meets the scale-free characteristics and has higher network efficiency and stronger network invulnerability which proves that the newly established model is reasonable.

articleTitle: Transforming Supply Chain Management with Big Data Analytics: A Pathway to Competitive Advantage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: To understand the application of big data analysis in supply chain management, the author suggests doing application research in supply chain management using big data analysis. Before exploring how Big data analysis may be used effectively in supply chain management, the author first examines the primary forms of this discipline. To increase the effectiveness of supply chain management, research should be done on how to connect the development of blockchain with big data. Finally, it has been demonstrated via the study of company instances that the application of Big Data analysis may assist supply chain firms in understanding consumer demands, which can then assist customers in selecting the best goods and services. Reaction time can be 40% faster than with conventional supply chain management; At the same time, the supply chain's effectiveness may be raised by roughly 26%, and supply chain integration will be greatly enhanced. The order cycle may be substantially optimized (by approximately 420%) and supply chain efficiency can be raised (by about 270%), if big data analysis technology is further applied to supply chain operations. With the continuous improvement of the national economy, Big data processing has been widely used in the daily work and life of modern audiences, fundamentally improving the overall work quality and efficiency of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Block Cipher Algorithm in the Design of Terminal Identity Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: With people's attention to information security, the research on authentication encryption algorithm has become a very important branch of cryptography in recent years. It is widely used in data encryption, message authentication, authentication and key management. In the network of large-scale communication nodes, there are a large quantity of network nodes and a variety of devices. The traditional PKI cryptosystem has the problems of certificate management difficulty and resource waste. Based on the research of block cipher algorithm, this article discusses its application in the design of terminal identity authentication system, and designs a node two-way authentication scheme based on identity encryption. The simulation results show that the block cipher algorithm proposed in this article can get 95.82%, accuracy, which is higher than the contrast algorithm. Authentication and encryption algorithm based on block cipher plays an important role in authentication and encryption algorithm because of its fast implementation speed of software and hardware and easy standardization. The research shows that the algorithm proposed in this article is superior to other algorithms in the application of terminal identity authentication system. It provides a new solution for related research.

articleTitle: Research on Information Management Platform for Prefabricated Components Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of lack of data management standards, data transmission bottlenecks, management information silo, low visibility, and insufficient data integration among production, transportation, and construction management units during the construction of prefabricated components, this study first analyzed the limitations of the traditional construction management model. Secondly, based on BIM technology, reengineer project level application processes, develop assembly based BIM modeling standards, and develop an information management platform for assembly based prefabricated components based on BIM technology. The case verification shows that the research results have effectively solved the above problems, and achieved the collaborative management goal of informationization, visualization, and digitization throughout the entire process of prefabricated component construction, improving the social and economic benefits of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on Target Tracking and Gesture Recognition System Combining Artificial Intelligence Algorithm and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Based on the continuous progress of information acquisition and information processing technology, computer vision, that is, how to use computer technology to efficiently and accurately obtain relevant information from environmental images or videos, and then analyze, judge and make decisions on things and phenomena in the objective world, has become a very important research topic. In this paper, a target tracking and gesture recognition model combining artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and computer vision is proposed. An improved local binary pattern feature operator is used to represent the gesture region, and a gesture classifier is formed after learning and counting the samples through convolutional neural network (CNN). The classifier is used to detect the specified gesture in the video. The simulation results show that when the number of test samples starts to increase, the gesture recognition accuracy of each method shows a downward trend. However, compared with the other two methods, the accuracy of target tracking and gesture recognition based on this method is obviously higher. Compared with the recognition method based on single feature, this method has higher overall recognition rate, and greatly improves the recognition rate of gestures with high local similarity.

articleTitle: Application of Genetic Algorithm Optimizing Neural Network in Mathematical Model Construction of Agricultural Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Agricultural economic forecast plays an important role in the long-term development of agricultural economy, which is related to a series of problems such as agricultural industrial layout and agricultural industrial structure adjustment. At present, the diversification of forecasting models has become the characteristic of quantitative economy research, and how to choose the most suitable forecasting method is very important. According to the structural characteristics of Neural network (NN) model, this paper proposes a method of applying Genetic Algorithm (GA) to NN combination. This study combines the performance of the adaptive learning efficiency enhancement algorithm and the additional momentum method to enhance the adaptive ability of the algorithm, and uses GA to improve the weights of the back propagation neural network (BPNN). It overcomes the shortcomings that NN model is easy to fall into local minima. The final simulation results show that the accuracy of the optimization algorithm proposed in this paper is high, which can reach 95.87%. At the same time, the algorithm has high efficiency and low error. When the first phase is predicted to happen, the second phase of the sample data can be taken as the first phase, forming a rolling “skylight” with a fixed quantity of intervals. This result shows that the performance of GA-BPNN model is better, and it can get better results than the conventional economic model when it is applied to the mathematical model of agricultural economic growth. It can provide some reference for related mathematical models of agricultural economic growth.

articleTitle: Research on Teaching Evaluation of English Mobile Reading Based on Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid development of science and technology, information technology is deeply integrated with education and teaching, which has promoted profound changes in education and teaching. In particular, the application of big data technology and mobile intelligent devices in teaching has been paid more and more attention, which has greatly changed students' reading content and reading methods. In this paper, big data algorithm is introduced into English reading teaching, that is, the data that can be perceived, collected, processed, managed and served in English reading teaching is changed from the way of paper storage for English reading teaching in the past to the way of data storage that can be collected by information technology. The results show that from the types of questions raised, the ways of selecting and answering questions and the ways of teachers' reasoning and answering, we can find that teachers can rely on rich teaching experience to locate teaching objectives very accurately when accepting classroom observation and evaluation. The analysis of big data algorithm provides great convenience for teaching evaluation.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Integrated Management System for Computer Room Based on Virtual Reality and BS Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the computer room scale and the rapid development of information technology, the complexity of the computer room environment increases, and it is more and more important for the management and inspection of the computer room. In order to strengthen the effective physical control of the computer room environment, it is urgent to develop a computer room management system based on VR (Virtual Reality) technology. This paper designs an intelligent integrated computer room management system integrating VR and BS architecture to solve the current problems. In this paper, computer tools are used to build the information and model of the equipment from the design drawings of the computer room, and the actual physical equipment is described by hierarchical model. The three-dimensional virtual computer room can be generated and updated through three-dimensional graphics technology. The overall architecture of the system can be divided into: access layer, service layer and storage layer. Unity3D is used to realize the dynamic loading of the scene, collision detection, equipment data acquisition and other functions according to the operating parameters. The alarm is displayed on the three-dimensional model. When the administrator processes the alarm message, the alarm can be eliminated from the three-dimensional model and the normal operation state can be displayed. Through the test, it is found that the number of system users has increased, and the CPU usage is normal. This system realizes the self-service management of the computer room and basically meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Damage Behavior of Fiber Reinforced Hydrogel Composite Sensor in Tensile Deformation Based on Direct FE2 Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Hydrogels are polymer materials with network structure formed by the hydration of polymer chains, which have received extensive attention in the fields of biomedicine and flexible electronics. However, pure water gel materials have problems such as low strength and poor toughness. The mechanical properties of hydrogel materials can be improved as a whole by adding strong fibers into the hydrogel matrix to form hydrogel composites, so as to enhance the practical value of hydrogels. Although there have been a lot of research reports on fiber reinforced hydrogel composites, the deformation mechanism of hydrogel composites has not yet been clarified; Compared to research methods such as experiments and constitutive modeling, numerical simulation methods have the advantages of being able to better compensate for the shortcomings of both research methods; However, the systematic numerical study of the deformation of continuous fiber reinforced hydrogel composites using the traditional finite element method requires a huge computational cost. Therefore, this paper selects a dual scale method Direct FE<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which can not only better capture the evolution of composite microstructure, but also greatly improve the computational efficiency, to carry out systematic numerical simulation on the deformation and failure behavior of fiber reinforced hydrogel composites with different microstructure characteristics, and discusses the influence of fiber microstructure characteristics on the deformation and failure of hydrogel composites based on the simulation results. The research results can provide guidance for the design, manufacturing, and engineering service reliability of FRHC sensors.

articleTitle: Intelligent Grid Edge Computing Application Research Utilising the Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: IoT-based smart grids, as a cutting-edge research direction in the energy field, have sparked extensive interest and research. In this context, As an emerging computing paradigm, edge computing presents new opportunities for smart grid implementation and optimisation. The purpose of this research is to investigate the implementation of peripheral computation in IoT-based smart infrastructure and its potential value and impact on power systems. In this study, we begin by introducing the fundamental concepts of IoT-based smart grid and edge computing, before describing their relationship and the function of edge computing in smart grid. Subsequently, we concentrate on specific smart grid application areas for peripheral computation. Including energy management, load balancing, fault monitoring, and real-time data analysis. By applying in these areas, edge computing can provide real-time data processing and decision support to achieve efficient operation and optimized management of power systems. Further, this study explores the challenges and opportunities presented by edge computing applications. We analyze the problems that edge computing may face in terms of data security, communication delay, and resource allocation, and propose corresponding solution strategies. At the same time, we emphasize the innovation and sustainability of edge computing applications in smart grids, providing new ideas and methods for the future development of power systems. Finally, this study summarizes the advantages and prospects of edge computing applications in smart grids based on IoT, and proposes directions for future research.

articleTitle: Predicting the Relationship between Stocks and Emotion Factors with GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: We try to predict the stock market using GAN model, which includes discriminator and generator. We use MLP as the predictor of the GAN which uses the Backpropagation. Besides, we use the Simon function to monitor the study of the model. Using the model, we have gotten the graph of three different companies in our paragraph. In addition, we use our model to predict the figure of we know and compare the error with the figure it is. Finally, we use the formula to calculate the RMSE.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Oral English Classroom Teaching Evaluation in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In order to improve the optimization effect of oral English teaching evaluation in colleges and universities, this paper constructs an oral English classroom evaluation model with evaluation function according to the actual requirements of the current society for oral English. The supporting environment designed in this paper will organize evaluation activities with intelligent terminals as the carrier, students will publish and reply to evaluation topics, participate in complete evaluation projects. Moreover, it will meet students' individual needs with the help of “evaluation cards”, “grouping” and “real-time feedback”, and promote the spiral rise of high-order thinking. Combined with the actual situation of oral English teaching in colleges and universities, the performance evaluation experiment of the model is carried out. Form the experimental verification results, it can be seen that the optimization model of oral English classroom evaluation proposed in this paper has obvious improvement compared with the traditional classroom evaluation model.

articleTitle: Big Data Analysis of National Security based on Network Traffic Metadata
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In the rapid development of network technology, scholars from various countries have put forward a number of research topics for the data security in the background of network traffic raw data. They not only clearly recognize the importance of national security big data analysis, but also master rich data resources from it, and build and promote the network traffic metadata diversion platform. From the perspective of the development of modern society, by studying the network traffic meta data diversion platform, designing metadata management model, creating a big data service platform, accurately identifying active data information, detecting and analyzing network attacks and abnormal traffic, we can finally use metadata to achieve standardized data management and truly achieve the expected data service demand. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the network traffic raw data and the research status of national security big data analysis, this paper detects and analyzes the main structure and application effect of the system according to the network security big data platform construction system under the network traffic metadata, so as to realize the basic requirements of data sharing and security management.

articleTitle: Real Time Estimation of GHG Emissions Using IoT Integrated Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: IoT integrated Sensor Fusion is utilised in this work to estimate greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. A system is proposed that utilizes IoT devices and environmental sensors to monitor and manage environmental impact efficiently in real-time. IoT-enabled sensors are strategically placed in industrial sites, metropolitan centres, and natural landscapes. These sensors measure CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, methane, nitrous oxide, and meteorology. Sensor fusion and real time data monitoring are the main contribution of this research work. The technology decreases uncertainty and improves estimation accuracy by integrating sensor data. Machine learning algorithms analyse fused sensor data and create predictive models. These models allow the system to extrapolate emission estimates beyond sensor locations, providing a comprehensive view of GHG emissions across geographies. IoT integration with sensor fusion and digital signal processing (DSP) allows real-time data transmission and remote monitoring. This continuously collects and processes emission data to quickly identify pollution hotspots and conduct emission reduction actions. The system's precision, real-time capabilities, scalability, and adaptability make it ideal for local air quality monitoring, regional emission tracking, and global climate change assessments. Finally, this research uses sensor fusion and IoT technology to estimate GHG emissions. The technology provides accurate, real-time emission estimations from several sensors, aiding environmental monitoring and sustainable development. This strategy could help mitigate climate change and create a green future.

articleTitle: Application of Real-time Direct Analysis Technology in Process Analysis of Food Pollution Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of food pollution monitoring, the use of real-time detection technology is an effective means to quickly produce results. In this paper, the real-time direct analysis technology is studied. According to the mechanism of paper spray and referring to other similar open ionization source technologies, a simple and convenient grid-free real-time direct analysis mass spectrometry injection device is designed and constructed, which uses the positive ion mode of mass spectrometer ESI for detection. By using the peel as the base, we can directly analyze the pesticide on the surface of the peel by mass spectrometry, simplify the monitoring system structure, eliminate the complex process in the detection process, and directly output the test results. Through the experimental analysis, we can see that the method proposed in this paper has a certain effect in the detection of food pollution, and further improve the convenience and efficiency on the basis of the traditional detection methods.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Particle Swarm Optimization for Intelligent Control of Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Affected by the train delay, there will be some unfavorable factors, which will reduce passengers' satisfaction with the service quality of the line, limit the ability to use the line and increase the train operation cost. Improving operation efficiency and reducing the delay caused by train delay are the primary problems to be solved in train dispatching. The train operation process is characterized by nonlinearity, high complexity and a large number of uncertainties, and the traditional control methods often require higher accuracy of mathematical models, so it is difficult for traditional control methods to achieve ideal results in this very complicated process. Aiming at the intelligent control model of rail transit, based on the traditional PSO(Particle swarm optimization) algorithm, this paper uses the idea of GA(genetic algorithm) to combine GA with PSO algorithm to get GA _ PSO algorithm. In GA _ PSO algorithm, the better offspring from the crossover of better parents replaces the inferior offspring, which accelerates the convergence of the algorithm to some extent and can obtain the particle near-optimal solution in fewer iterations. The simulation results show that a new adjustment plan is finally produced after the adjustment of GA_PSO algorithm, which solves the problem of single car and train group delay well. Therefore, it is feasible to use GA _ PSO algorithm to solve the intelligent control problem of rail transit.

articleTitle: Large-scale Research Project Management System Design with Multi-level Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The main work of a university is teaching and scientific research (SR). In this paper, an optimization model of large-scale SR project management information system (MIS) based on multi-level structure is proposed, and the accumulated SR information is mined by using the technology of association mining, in order to try to find the key factors that affect SR results, and make full use of the advantages of the network, so that the information management of SR projects in the whole school can be realized efficiently and scientifically through the network. The simulation results show that the information mining accuracy of this model is stable around ninety-seven percent, and the real-time wavelength tends to be stable, which is 18.44% higher than the traditional algorithm on average. It can provide scientific basis for leading, organizing, coordinating SR work between teachers and students and making SR decisions. Obtaining scientific basis and enlightenment through data mining (DM) can guide universities to seek reasonable teaching mode and guide teachers and students to carry out effective SR work, which can completely make universities develop healthily and steadily in a good direction.

articleTitle: Research on Global Path Planning System of Driverless Car Based on Improved RRT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Global path planning is that driverless car obtains a collision-free feasible path from the driving space that meets the constraints of its own vehicle, while safety, stationarity and efficiency are important indicators to measure whether the planned path of driverless car is optimal. Aiming at the shortcomings of RRT (Rapidly-exploring Random Trees) algorithm, such as discontinuous planning path and poor practicability, this paper studies the improvement of global path planning algorithm on the basis of basic RRT algorithm. And a global path planning system of driverless car based on improved RRT algorithm is established. The heuristic search mechanism of expanding the target node domain and biased target sampling is used to pull the random tree to grow to the target point, which speeds up the search. Pruning sampling space, regularizing vehicle shape, pruning function and B-spline smooth curve are used to meet the constraints and improve the path quality. The research results show that the average number of sampling nodes and global path planning time of RRT and improved RRT algorithms are reduced by about 50%, the average path length is shortened by nearly 50%, and the maximum curvature of the planned path is only about 16.7% of that of RRT algorithm. This shows that the performance of RRT and improved RRT algorithm for global path planning of driverless car is far better than RRT algorithm.

articleTitle: Unequal Loop Hierarchical Routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks with Balanced Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Each sensor node in wireless sensor networks can only be equipped with a small battery with limited energy due to its size, so energy consumption is very important for sensor networks. In this paper, based on the energy balance goal of the whole network, a sub-optimal hierarchical network routing with unequal loops is designed based on the aggregation node as the center and the topological distance in a uniformly distributed sensor node environment. The simulation results show that the layered routing model prolonging the life cycle of the network, improving the utilization efficiency of nodes, and achieving the goal of energy balance of most nodes in the network.

articleTitle: Intelligent Planning Algorithm Design of Urban Drainage Pipe Network Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In light of China's burgeoning economic development, the trajectory of urbanization has witnessed a rapid surge. Concurrent with this trend is a predicament characterized by inadequacies and lags in urban infrastructure. This work endeavours to establish comprehensive graphic and attribute databases about urban drainage systems, subsequently marshalling the prowess of Geographic Information System (GIS) technology to administer said data efficaciously. Moreover, a concerted effort is exerted to enhance the algorithm tailored to the idiosyncratic contexts of drainage network modeling. To this end, an ameliorated variant of the Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm is invoked to orchestrate the optimization of Urban Drainage Pipe Networks (UDPNs). Reflecting upon the intrinsic attributes of the Chaotic PSO paradigm, judicious recalibration of control parameters is undertaken. Notably, the historiographical data appraisal mechanism of the PSO position is assimilated to curtail superfluous chaotic iterations, thereby succinctly truncating algorithmic runtime and enhancing optimization robustness. The empirical findings of this inquiry incontrovertibly evince that juxtaposed against the conventional PSO algorithm within an equivalent environmental model; the refined algorithm ostensibly excels in path optimization performance. Evidently proficient in circumventing local optima inherent to the environmental model, the refined algorithm remarkably expedites convergence towards the global optimum. Computational analysis substantiates that the augmented Chaotic PSO algorithm efficaciously signifies itself as an instrumental conduit for the optimal design of drainage pipe networks.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Management System of Equipment State Sensing and Control in Intelligent Power Distribution Room Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: This article presents the research and development of an advanced integrated management system for intelligent sensing and controlling equipment states in distribution rooms, leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) technology. This system enables comprehensive monitoring of distribution rooms, catering to measurement requirements spanning metrology, production, electrical parameters, and environmental conditions. The study addresses three critical facets of enhancing distribution network monitoring: integration of diverse data sources, data fusion optimization, and model validation through splicing. Incorporating an attention mechanism, the system employs a novel hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based on ResNet architecture, facilitating early intelligent monitoring and alert generation for power distribution equipment. Empirical testing of the system underscores its efficacy, with minimal transmission loss and robust communication quality, especially for distances under 100 meters. Notably surpassing conventional techniques, the hybrid network demonstrates an impressive 93% accuracy in predicting fault types, rendering it well-suited for fault detection across various scenarios.

articleTitle: Advancing Breast Cancer Diagnosis: A Comprehensive Study of Machine Learning Algorithms on Histological Tumor Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Breast cancer is a prevalent and consequential form of cancer that impacts women globally, leading to a substantial number of newly diagnosed cases and fatalities. Its early detection is crucial for improved prognosis and survival rates, as it allows for timely medical intervention. Accurate differentiation between benign and malignant tumors also helps prevent unnecessary treatments. As a result, substantial research is dedicated to precise breast cancer diagnosis and categorization of patients. Machine learning (ML) methods are greatly appreciated in this domain because of their capacity to recognize essential characteristics within intricate datasets, rendering them the favored methodology for pattern classification and prediction in breast cancer studies. The main objective of this research is to investigate how ML techniques can be applied in the diagnosis and prognosis of breast cancer. It begins with an overview of ML techniques such as Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Test Random Forest Classifier, and PCR. Afterward, the research examines how these techniques are applied in breast cancer studies, focusing on the utilization of the Wisconsin breast cancer database (WBCD) as the main data source for comparing outcomes obtained from various algorithms. Additionally, the study introduces a healthcare system model derived from recent research. The findings indicate that machine learning models offer specific contributions to breast cancer diagnosis. However, they also highlight the necessity for additional accuracy refinement.

articleTitle: Design of Rolling Bearing Fault Monitoring System Based on Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Considering the abnormal situation of rolling bearings during operation, a monitoring system based wireless communication was designed. The temperature and vibration frequency information of rolling bearings during operation was collected through industrial sensors. When the monitoring data was abnormal, the system issued an audible and visual alarm, and it was sent to the gateway system through LoRa wireless communication. The system uses ASR6601, which combines a LoRa modem and MCU, as the main control chip, facilitating data processing and LoRa wireless communication, greatly reducing costs and ensuring data reliability.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality English Intelligent Translation System Based on Multi-Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: At its annual conference on May 8, 2018, Google unveiled the Google Assistant, an AI that passes the Turing test and can converse with real people without any lag or logical errors while also understanding them. The Google Assistant can help people order food, book travel arrangements, and more. Today's AI translation has no errors in basic grammar, has become more logical, and some software can even combine context, and the results of human translation are no different. Communication between speakers of different languages is increasing as global economic integration deepens, and there are many opportunities for MT on the market. AI translation has widespread commercial applications and a sizable market, but also uses language as a link, radiates widely, and drives economic, cultural and other all-round exchanges. However, the existing English intelligent translation system (ITS) has obvious shortcomings, such as slow speed, low translation accuracy and large translation error. This text proposes a new English ITS: virtual reality (VR) English ITS in view of multi-sensor data (MSD). The VR English ITS in view of MSD proposed in this text has improved the BLUE scores of three types of sentences. Among them, the score of complex sentences increased by 50.7%. This text compares the decoding translation method given tree translation method (labeled method A) and the decoding machine English translation method given forest translation method (labeled method B) with the VR English intelligent translation method in view of MSD (labeled method C) proposed in this text. The experimental results show that the VR English intelligent system in view of MSD has the highest score, 48.9 points.

articleTitle: Method and System for Collaborative Schedule of Supply Chain Production and Transportation Based on Improve Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: In the traditional supply chain management methods, the collaborative scheduling decisions of supply chain production and transportation are independent of each other, and their coordination is often ignored. Independent production scheduling decision and distribution scheduling decision can not make the operation level of supply chain optimal, especially in the supply chain system with very limited transportation resources. In this paper, the improved PSO(Particle swarm optimization) algorithm is applied to optimize the collaborative scheduling problem of production and transportation in supply chain. Combining the strong global search ability of GA(genetic algorithm) and the fast convergence speed of PSO algorithm, a hybrid algorithm is constructed by complementing each other's advantages. The research results show that the hybrid algorithm has better optimization performance, which proves that the hybrid algorithm has better performance, and has the advantages of fast convergence speed of PSO algorithm and strong global search ability of GA. It can effectively solve the problem of collaborative scheduling of production and transportation in supply chain.

articleTitle: The Driving Effect of Data Mining Technology on the Development of Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Based on the viewpoint that Large-scale information affected the economic and social development, the author established a theoretical model of the impact of Large-scale information on green economic growth in the framework of endogenous technological progress. Technical progress is analyzed from two aspects: neutral technical progress and biased technical progress. Neutral technical progress driven by big data affects economic growth, while biased technical progress caused by big data affects environmental quality. The theory reveals the mechanism and path that big data affects technological progress, economic growth, environmental quality, environmental regulation policies, etc., and verifies the above theory through numerical Analog verification. The author aims to reveal the endogenous impact of big data on green economic growth, creatively explain the theoretical mechanism and path of big data driving green economic growth, and expand the theoretical construction method of big data driven endogenous economic growth, so as to solve the mechanism obstacles and policy gaps encountered in the process of green economic development in the big data era; The author reconstructs the theory of green economic growth under the influence of large numbers, providing theoretical support for China's current Big data development strategy.

articleTitle: Innovative Practice and Application of Blockchain Technology Under the Mode of Integration of Production and Learning in Financial Talent Training
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The rapid development of innovative Internet technology, represented by blockchain technology, has made de-intermediation finance feasible, significantly improved the availability of financing for the integration of small and medium-sized industries and universities, and reduced the financing cost of the integration of small and medium-sized industries and universities, so as to promote industrial transformation and upgrading through financial innovation. However, the development of talent training in supply chain finance in China is facing development bottlenecks such as information asymmetry, difficulty in verifying trade authenticity, and data security issues. With the rise of blockchain technology, people find that it has the characteristics of traceability, non-tampering, decentralization and so on, which can well solve the problems that hinder the training and development of supply chain financial talents. The financial platform built by using blockchain technology can optimize the convenience, timeliness and accuracy of the process in the transaction, reduce the possibility of dishonest behavior in the transaction, improve the convenience of trade financing, and establish a more high-quality and information-symmetric transaction mode for the society. Starting from the constraints of traditional supply chain finance talent training, this paper analyzes and summarizes the main development models of supply chain finance talent training at present, points out the core problems, and then studies the feasibility, value and significance of the application of blockchain technology in supply chain finance talent training from a theoretical perspective.

articleTitle: Stock Price Forecasting Using Machine Learning Techniques: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: Investment strategies in the stock market are intricate, hinging upon the analysis of extensive datasets. Recently, there has been a growing interest in leveraging machine learning techniques to determine their potential in enhancing market predictions compared to conventional methods. This study aims to pinpoint potential pathways for future research in machine learning-driven stock market forecasting by delving into existing literature. Employing a systematic literature review approach, relevant peer-reviewed journal articles from the past two decades are identified and grouped based on their shared methodologies and contexts. From this analysis, four key categories emerge: investigations employing artificial neural networks, research centered on support vector machines, inquiries that fuse genetic algorithms with other approaches, and those integrating hybrid or alternative artificial intelligence methodologies. Each category's studies are scrutinized to uncover shared discoveries, distinctive insights, limitations, and areas demanding further exploration. The conclusive segment presents overarching deductions and outlines for prospective research endeavors.

articleTitle: Data Extraction and Analysis in Network Security Anti-attack Detection Based on Artificial Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The significance of accurate detection rules is paramount in identifying network security incidents, as precision plays a pivotal role in minimizing both false positives and false negatives. To achieve this goal, the establishment of effective detection rules becomes imperative. The advent of artificial neural network intrusion detection systems has significantly bolstered the effectiveness of identifying such breaches. Capitalizing on neural networks' capacity to learn and categorize data, the utilization of elastic propagation neural networks for identifying simulated attacks has gained substantial traction. The traditional manual configuration of detection rules is not only time-intensive and arduous but also lacks efficiency. Recent times have witnessed the emergence of intrusion detection as a novel and proactive defense mechanism, assuming a crucial position in the realm of network security technology. Building upon a comprehensive analysis of existing intrusion detection research, this study delves into data analysis and adaptive modeling within intrusion detection systems, subsequently scrutinizing and enhancing the shortcomings of optimized neural networks. This study proposes a refined neural network, and through integration with a feature extraction approach and the enhanced algorithm, formulates an intrusion detection model that exhibits commendable accuracy, as validated through experimentation.

articleTitle: Construction Research on Quality Feature Dictionary of Medical Services Based on Tongyici Cilin and Word2vec Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: As the foundation work for natural language processing tasks such as sentiment analysis and text classification, the quality and accuracy of feature dictionaries directly affect the performance of models and the precision of results. Given the particularity of the medical services field, there is still a shortage of high-quality feature dictionaries in the medical services domain. In this paper, we utilize patients' medical services review corpus to select high-frequency seed words and classify them using the TF -IDF algorithm. Then, we expand the feature words by calculating the similarity between seed words using Tongyici Cilin (a Chinese synonym dictionary) and Word2vec, aiming to find a more precise and comprehensive feature extraction method, and construct a feature dictionary for medical services quality. This method is concise and efficient, and can effectively improve the sentiment analysis and text classification effects for medical texts, playing a key role in the field of medical services.

articleTitle: Progress of Spatial Geographic Phenomenon Visualization Methods Based on Multi-Source Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The generation of massive and complex data in the context of the big data era, the rapid development of 5G technology and mathematical and statistical methods have made the spatial visualization methods of multi-source data more and more abundant. Different methods are applicable to different fields and data forms; therefore, the analysis for research methods has become an important topic. 698 papers from CNKI and Web of Science Core Collection from 2015–2021 are selected as samples. Citespace is used to analyze the papers to find out the research hotspots and the development history of the past seven years at home and abroad about the field of spatial visualization based on multi-source data, then concluding that domestic research areas are mostly focused on first-tier cities. The foreign research areas mostly focus on climate change, precipitation and green space, and both domestic and foreign research methods are dominated by machine learning. Further, three research methods commonly used in spatial visualization are summarized and analyzed, especially the machine learning method, to provide more scientific and effective new ideas for spatial visualization research.

articleTitle: Analyzing Market Volatility: Big Data's Insight into Macroeconomic Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The synergy between macroeconomic indicators and real estate market volatility, seamlessly integrated with the agility of big data analytics, ushers in a paradigm shift in investment insights. This fusion unravels the intricate connections between economic forces and the fluid dynamics of the real estate landscape, offering actionable insights for stakeholders. Through the amalgamation of diverse data sources, sentiment analysis, and predictive modeling within the realm of big data, investors gain a holistic understanding of market behaviors. Particularly noteworthy is the role of volatility indices like the VIX, which metamorphose into real-time pulse monitors, mirroring market sentiments. The incorporation of alternative data sources adds an extra dimension, providing a richer tapestry of insights into the impact of macroeconomic shifts. As the global economic panorama continues to evolve, this synergistic relationship equips investors with the tools to orchestrate proactive investment strategies, steering real estate decisions with precision amid the waves of economic uncertainty.

articleTitle: Study on the Use of the Ant Colony Algorithm and Genetic Algorithm for Travelling Salesman Problem Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Data Science & Informatics (ICDSI)
abstract: The conventional ant colony algorithm encounters challenges of sluggish convergence and susceptibility to local optima when applied to solving the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). On the other hand, the genetic algorithm boasts a robust global search capability and widespread adoption. Yet, the genetic algorithm's reliance on binary coding for crossover and mutation operations poses limitations when handling city sequences inherent in the TSP. Addressing these limitations, a novel approach termed the ACAG (Algorithm Combined by ACA and GA) algorithm is proposed, which synergistically merges the strengths of both the ant colony algorithm and genetic algorithm. By infusing a greedy strategy into the ant colony algorithm's decision-making process, the algorithm restricts the selection of the subsequent city to those proximate to the current city. This targeted selection greatly enhances search velocity and expedites convergence towards the optimal solution. As the algorithm iterates, it dynamically transitions from the ant colony algorithm to the genetic algorithm. This strategic shift capitalizes on the genetic algorithm's global search proficiency, expanding the solution space and mitigating the risk of becoming ensnared in local optima. Consequently, rapid attainment of the optimal solution becomes achievable. Empirical trials corroborate the algorithm's superior performance when juxtaposed against both traditional ant colony algorithms and genetic algorithms. In conclusion, the ACAG algorithm offers a promising breakthrough for tackling the TSP conundrum. By harmonizing the advantages of the ant colony and genetic algorithms, this novel approach circumvents the shortcomings of slow convergence and local optima entrapment. The algorithm's ability to swiftly converge towards optimal solutions showcases its potential for outperforming conventional methods. Future research avenues might encompass fine-tuning algorithm parameters and exploring its applicability in various problem domains.
